```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
```

# ABE Allele Counts Analysis

## Load ABE Counts
```{r load-abe}
abe_df <- read.csv("ABEPyDESEQ2CountTable.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
# Transpose so rows = genes/alleles, cols = samples
abe_counts <- t(as.matrix(abe_df))
```

## Prepare Metadata for ABE
```{r metadata-abe}
samples_abe <- colnames(abe_counts)
condition_abe <- ifelse(grepl("^CD19minus", samples_abe), "minus", "plus")
coldata_abe <- data.frame(
  row.names = samples_abe,
  condition = factor(condition_abe, levels = c("minus", "plus"))
)
```

## Run DESeq2 for ABE
```{r dds-abe}
dds_abe <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = abe_counts,
  colData   = coldata_abe,
  design    = ~ condition
)

# Set WT as control (optional)
ctrl <- which(rownames(dds_abe) == "wt")
dds_abe <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_abe, controlGenes = ctrl)

dds_abe <- DESeq(dds_abe)
res_abe <- results(dds_abe, contrast = c("condition", "plus", "minus"))
```

## ABE Results
```{r summary-abe}
summary(res_abe)
head(res_abe)
```

```{r write-abe}
write.csv(as.data.frame(res_abe), file = "ABE_DESeq2_results_WTctrl_final.csv")
```

# ABE Allele Counts Analysis (All Variants)

## Load ABE Counts
```{r load-abe}
abe_df_allvariants <- read.csv("ABEPyDESEQ2CountTableAllVariants.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
# Transpose so rows = genes/alleles, cols = samples
abe_counts_allvariants <- t(as.matrix(abe_df_allvariants))
```

## Prepare Metadata for ABE
```{r metadata-abe}
samples_abe <- colnames(abe_counts_allvariants)
condition_abe <- ifelse(grepl("^CD19minus", samples_abe), "minus", "plus")
coldata_abe <- data.frame(
  row.names = samples_abe,
  condition = factor(condition_abe, levels = c("minus", "plus"))
)
```

## Run DESeq2 for ABE
```{r dds-abe}
dds_abe_allvariants <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = abe_counts_allvariants,
  colData   = coldata_abe,
  design    = ~ condition
)

# Set WT as control (optional)
ctrl <- which(rownames(dds_abe_allvariants) == "wt") # COMMENT OUT FOR NO CONTROL
dds_abe_allvariants <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_abe_allvariants, controlGenes = ctrl) # COMMENT OUT FOR NO CONTROL

dds_abe_allvariants <- DESeq(dds_abe_allvariants)
res_abe_allvariants <- results(dds_abe_allvariants, contrast = c("condition", "plus", "minus"))
```

## ABE Results
```{r summary-abe}
summary(res_abe_allvariants)
head(res_abe_allvariants)
```
```{r write-abe}
write.csv(as.data.frame(res_abe_allvariants), file = "ABE_DESeq2_results_WTctrl_AllVariants_final_v2.csv")
```

## MA Plots
```{r ma-plots, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
plotMA(res_abe, main = "ABE: MA Plot", ylim = c(-5, 5))
plotMA(res_abe_allvariants, main = "ABE AllVariants: MA Plot", ylim = c(-5, 5))
```


# ABE per-replicate scores
```{r}
# VST-transform the restricted ABE dataset
vsd_abe <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_abe, blind = TRUE)
vmat_abe <- assay(vsd_abe)

# Build helper metadata with replicate labels like "rep1", "rep2", ...
meta_abe <- as.data.frame(colData(vsd_abe)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rep = stringr::str_extract(sample, "rep\\d+"))

# Replicates that have BOTH conditions (minus & plus)
reps_abe <- intersect(
  meta_abe %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "minus") %>% dplyr::pull(rep),
  meta_abe %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "plus")  %>% dplyr::pull(rep)
)

# Compute per-replicate LFC = (plus - minus) on the VST (log-like) scale
lfc_list_abe <- lapply(reps_abe, function(r) {
  s_plus  <- meta_abe %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "plus",  rep == r) %>% dplyr::pull(sample)
  s_minus <- meta_abe %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "minus", rep == r) %>% dplyr::pull(sample)
  stopifnot(length(s_plus) == 1, length(s_minus) == 1)
  vmat_abe[, s_plus, drop = TRUE] - vmat_abe[, s_minus, drop = TRUE]
})

lfc_mat_abe <- do.call(cbind, lfc_list_abe)
colnames(lfc_mat_abe) <- reps_abe
rownames(lfc_mat_abe) <- rownames(vmat_abe)

# Save and show correlations
write.csv(lfc_mat_abe, file = "ABE_vst_perrep_LFC_v2.csv")
cor_abe <- cor(lfc_mat_abe, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
print(cor_abe)

```

```{r}
pairs(
  lfc_mat_abe,
  main = "ABE8e (restricted): per-replicate VST LFC (plus − minus)",
  pch = 19, cex = 0.4
)
```
